updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is consolidating all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This streamlines the workflow for compliance officers and security teams managing data classification across the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – Ability to protect files in excluded Windows folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is expanding coverage to protect sensitive data stored in commonly excluded Windows folders such as Temp and AppData, which were previously outside normal DLP scanning. This enhancement reduces blind spots in data protection by monitoring folders attackers frequently target or where sensitive data may be inadvertently stored.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance – Enhanced Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Communication Compliance policies now support detection of messages sent to and from external email addresses, OR logic to combine multiple conditions, and pre-implementation condition testing. These enhancements give compliance officers more precise control over communication monitoring and reduce false positives in policy enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Scanner data export for custom reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection actions to SQL tables, enabling compliance teams to build custom reports on the state of scanned repositories. This gives admins deeper insights into their data protection posture across file shares and hybrid environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management is introducing secure priority cleanup workflows that enable hard deletion of content in OneDrive and SharePoint beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. Compliance admins can now enforce permanent data removal for retention policy compliance while maintaining audit trails and safeguards against accidental deletion.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Legacy Teams retention policies will no longer govern Copilot
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams that currently cover Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, no longer implicitly applying to Copilot workloads. Compliance officers should review and update retention policies to ensure Copilot data is governed separately according to organizational requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – FTP and SFTP transfer monitoring (General Availability)
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now generally supports monitoring sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols with restrictive actions based on policy. Security teams can configure these transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to prevent data exfiltration through file transfer protocols.

updates.title: Microsoft Edge: 11 Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Chromium
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge has patched 11 authorization-related vulnerabilities inherited from Chromium affecting components including Video, Chromoting, BrowserTag, Downloads, WebProtect, USB, Select, SiteIsolation, Extensions, Core, and BFCache. Organizations should apply these patches promptly to prevent privilege escalation and unauthorized access through Edge.
